summary: Frontend-only regression test of 10 perf optimizations (B1-B4, F1-F6) using merchant onarrival21@gmail.com against preview eddcc06a. Login POST returned 200 in 1162ms and redirected to /dashboard (validates B1 immediate response). Dashboard rendered volume ($763.14, 17 payments), 7-day volume chart, Fee Tier Progress card ($27,883.35/$100,000), quick actions — no skeletons stuck after 6s hydration wait (validates F1 waterfall collapse + B3 cache writes). Wallet page rendered with well-formed USD amounts ($27,883.35 total; per-chain $13,943.66, $2,593.01, $1,717.23, $18.66, $29.44, $966.72, $8,614.63) with zero NaN/undefined/Infinity tokens (validates B4 Promise.all parallelization). Transactions and Company pages loaded cleanly. Verified merchant accessed /dashboard, /wallet, /transactions, /company with NO 'Please verify your email address' 403 block (validates B2 auth cache read). Repeat visit /transactions -> /dashboard re-rendered instantly to the same populated state (F2 SWR localStorage persistence works qualitatively). Zero 5xx /api responses. No React crashes or pageerrors in console.

issues: Recharts logs transient 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warning during initial container measure — cosmetic, chart still renders correctly. Consider setting explicit min dimensions on ResponsiveContainer to silence.
Next/Image warning for hexagon-icon.svg: width or height modified but not the other — add `style={{height:'auto'}}` or explicit both dims.

action_items: No functional regressions from B1-B4/F1-F6 detected — safe to keep the optimizations.
Minor cosmetic: silence Recharts width(-1) warning on Volume chart by giving ResponsiveContainer a minHeight or aspect ratio.
Minor cosmetic: fix Next/Image aspect-ratio warning on hexagon-icon.svg.
critical_code_review_comments: B1 finalizeLogin setImmediate pattern is correct but ensure any thrown error inside the deferred block is logged (setImmediate errors that go uncaught can crash the Node process on some versions — wrap in try/catch or .catch()).
B2 auth cache invalidation on email verify: confirm the cache key is also cleared on password change / logout to avoid stale email_verified reads across sessions.

F2 SWR localStorage persistence: cap payload size and namespace by user_id (looks intended per file list) to prevent one huge dashboard payload from evicting other keys or leaking across accounts on shared browsers.
seed_data_creation: None (READ-ONLY testing against prod DB in SAFE MODE, as instructed)
